metadata.task: Pick up the patient file and place it on the nurse station desk.

plan.goal: Pick up the patient file and place it on the nurse station desk.

checkpoints.checkpoint_goal: Navigate to the Reception area to locate the patient file.
checkpoints.exit_state: Robot is at the Reception desk where the patient file is located.

grounded_skills.reason: The robot needs to move from the Main Entrance to the Reception room to access the patient file. This skill uses Nav2 to navigate to a semantic location.

checkpoints.checkpoint_goal: Detect the patient file on the reception desk.
checkpoints.entry_state: Robot is at the Reception desk.
checkpoints.exit_state: Robot has detected the patient file and estimated its pose.

grounded_skills.reason: The robot must perceive the patient file to interact with it. This skill uses the vision system to detect objects in the scene.

checkpoints.checkpoint_goal: Estimate the precise 3D pose of the patient file.
checkpoints.entry_state: Robot has detected the patient file.
checkpoints.exit_state: Robot has an accurate 3D pose estimate of the patient file.

grounded_skills.reason: Accurate grasp requires a precise 3D pose estimate of the object, which is derived from depth perception and object detection data.

checkpoints.checkpoint_goal: Move the arm to a safe approach pose above the patient file.
checkpoints.entry_state: Robot has the pose of the patient file.
checkpoints.exit_state: Robot arm is positioned above the patient file, ready to grasp.

grounded_skills.reason: The manipulator must move to a collision-free pose above the object before attempting to grasp it. MoveIt2 plans the joint trajectory.

checkpoints.entry_state: Robot arm is positioned above the patient file.
checkpoints.exit_state: Robot is holding the patient file securely.

grounded_skills.reason: This skill executes the grasp and lift operation using MoveIt2 to move the end-effector to the grasp pose and close the gripper.

checkpoints.checkpoint_goal: Navigate to the Nurse Station desk.
checkpoints.entry_state: Robot is holding the patient file at the Reception desk.
checkpoints.exit_state: Robot is at the Nurse Station desk.

grounded_skills.reason: The robot must navigate to the new target location (Nurse Station) while carrying the object. Nav2 handles the path planning.

checkpoints.checkpoint_goal: Move the arm to a safe placement pose on the Nurse Station desk.
checkpoints.entry_state: Robot is at the Nurse Station desk holding the file.
checkpoints.exit_state: Robot arm is positioned over the desk surface, ready to place the file.

grounded_skills.reason: The manipulator must move to a pose where the object can be safely released on the target surface.

checkpoints.checkpoint_goal: Place the patient file on the Nurse Station desk.
checkpoints.entry_state: Robot arm is positioned over the desk surface.
checkpoints.exit_state: Robot has released the patient file on the desk.

grounded_skills.reason: This skill executes the release operation using MoveIt2 to move the end-effector to the target pose and open the gripper.

constraints: Robot has single arm only (cannot use two hands).
Robot cannot climb stairs (must use elevators/wheels).

execution_summary.expected_outcome: The robot successfully navigates to the Reception, detects and picks up the patient file, navigates to the Nurse Station, and places the file on the desk.
